title.title: Pointwise multiple ergodic averages for mixing transformations

plain: Take readings at evenly spaced times, multiply and average them: does that average always settle down?

steps: Rokhlin's multiple mixing pins down what the limit must be
A harmonic-analysis bound, moved into the system, forces convergence

voice.text: Average readings at times k, two k, three k. Does that settle at almost every start?
Rokhlin's mixing theorem names the limit; a harmonic analysis bound forces convergence.
Claimed: yes, for every mixing system.
